name: Ceramic Heart
source:
In the year 298 of the Kingdom Cecilia, Princess Selena has reached her 18th birthday. King has no male heir, so he announces a public competition for his daughter's hand. For five weeks the strongest adventurers will challenge monsters in this race for the throne. Main character is a newcomer who overhears the news and decides to try his luck.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
塞西莉亚王国298年，赛琳娜公主迎来了18岁生日。金没有男性继承人，因此他宣布公开争夺女儿的手。五个星期以来，最强大的冒险家将在这场王位争夺战中挑战怪物。主角是一位新来的人，无意中听到这个消息，决定碰碰运气。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
